summary.text: Lynn Dike is a Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Addison-4 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has run for office in Addison County several times before, including the Vermont House in 2020 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: Lynn Dike was a candidate for the Addison District seat in the Vermont State Senate and lost that general election, according to Ballotpedia, which lists the contest in its 2016 election history.
She advanced from Republican primaries for the Addison-4 House district in 2020 and 2022 and lost both general elections to incumbent Democrats Caleb Elder and Mari Cordes.
Dike advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026, with 342 votes, ahead of Chanin Hill.
